sql: SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id AS account_number, (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F') AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district);
